verdict.rationale: GitHub docs explicitly advertise a 'Dockerized Setup: Optimized Docker image with FastAPI server for easy deployment,' and community discussion references one-click Docker setups for production use with n8n/FastAPI. However, no evidence of official OpenAPI spec (404s on probes), and community notes highlight that developers must add their own production hardening (rate limiting, bot mitigation, session handling) on top of the container.
